Repair User Guide — Change to RUG

Type 5: Under Warranty (External not RUG) To Under Warranty - RUG

Source: Odoo Tour Recorder export — Tour/5A. Repair User Guide - Under Warranty ( External not RUG ) To Under Warranty - RUG.json

Scenario: A repair ticket is started as Under Warranty (External not RUG). When the RUG facility is granted, the ticket type is changed to Under Warranty - RUG, the warranty card is attached and the normal RUG process continues.
Every screenshot below is a real capture from a single, clean, passing automated run — taken before each step's action, with the element to use framed in red.

1. Overview

This manual explains how to change a repair ticket that was started under the Under Warranty (External not RUG) type to the Under Warranty - RUG type. The ticket is created at the receiving branch for a Factory Repair, and while it is still of type External not RUG the Change to RUG button is used. Because the RUG facility requires proof of warranty, the Warranty Details tab must then be completed by attaching the warranty card, after which the normal RUG process continues with Return.

When the type can be changed

  1. At the time the ticket was created, before the return was received (shown in this manual).
  2. After receiving the return, before sending it to the factory.
  3. After being sent from the centre, and before being received at the factory.
  4. After receiving from the factory, and before creating a task.

After any one of these cases, the warranty details must be attached, then the normal RUG process is followed.

Ticket stages covered

New

Before you start

  • You have access to the Helpdesk app.
  • The active company (top bar) is Jinasena Agricultural Machinery (Pvt) Ltd.
  • The customer and the finished product (with its serial number, already sold through a sales order) already exist in Odoo.
  • A picture of the customer's warranty card is available on your computer.

Section A — Create the Repair Ticket under External not RUG (Steps 1–10)

1 Open the HelpDesk app
NavigationOdoo Home → Apps
ActionClick the Helpdesk app icon on the home screen.
DescriptionOpens the Helpdesk Overview dashboard, showing every support team you have access to.
Odoo Apps home screen — Helpdesk app icon
2 Open the repair tickets
NavigationHelpdesk → Overview → Customer Care - Repair
ActionOn the Customer Care - Repair team card, click Tickets.
DescriptionDisplays the created tickets and their information.
Helpdesk Overview — Tickets button on the Customer Care - Repair team card
3 Create a new ticket
NavigationHelpdesk → Customer Care - Repair (Tickets)
ActionClick New at the top-left of the ticket list.
DescriptionOpens a blank Helpdesk ticket form for the repair item.
All Tickets list — New button
4 Assign the ticket to yourself
NavigationNew ticket form
ActionClick Assign to Me in the status bar.
DescriptionSaves the ticket for the first time and assigns it to the current user. This also generates the ticket's sequence-based name (e.g. REPAIR/2026/01681).
Blank new ticket form — Assign to Me button
5 Set the repair Type
NavigationTicket form → Type field
ActionClick the Type field and select Repair - Under Warranty - External not RUG.
DescriptionThe ticket is first registered as an Under Warranty (External not RUG) repair. The item is identified by an existing Serial Number.
Ticket form — Type field
6 Set the Return Receipt Location
NavigationTicket form → Return Receipt Location field
ActionClick Return Receipt Location and select the branch receiving the item (e.g. BR-AM/Stock, Jinasena Ampara Branch).
DescriptionSelect the location where you would like to receive the product for repair.
Ticket form — Return Receipt Location field
7 Select the Repair Reason
NavigationTicket form → Repair Reason field
ActionClick Repair Reason and select the reported fault (e.g. Difficult to start the engine).
DescriptionA list of common errors is provided; select the ones that apply.
Ticket form — Repair Reason field
8 Select the Job Location
NavigationTicket form → Job Location field
ActionIn Job Location, select Factory Repair.
DescriptionDefines where the repair will be performed. Factory Repair means the item is repaired at the factory.
Ticket form — Job Location field
9 Select the Customer
NavigationTicket form → Customer field
ActionClick Customer and select KURUNEGALA CASH CUSTOMER.
DescriptionEmail and Phone are filled automatically from the customer record.
Ticket form — Customer field
10 Enter the Serial Number
NavigationTicket form → Serial Number field
ActionClick Serial Number, type the serial number of the finished product (e.g. 0701_002) and select it from the list.
DescriptionSelect the correct serial number. Only serials already sold to a customer are offered. Selecting it fills in the Product automatically (here [JMC6] Multi Chopper 6Hp (Tractor Type)).
Ticket form — Serial Number field
Ticket form — Serial Number entered, Product filled in

Section B — Change the Type to RUG (Step 11)

11 Change to RUG
NavigationTicket form → status bar
ActionClick Change to RUG.
DescriptionIf you have met the qualifications required to receive the RUG facility at this point, or if a higher official has approved it, you can change the repair type with this button. The Type of the ticket changes from Repair - Under Warranty - External not RUG to Repair - Under Warranty - RUG (see the Type field in the later screenshots) and the Warranty Details tab becomes mandatory.
Ticket form — Change to RUG button

Section C — Attach the Warranty Details (Steps 12–13)

12 Open the Warranty Details tab
NavigationTicket form → Warranty Details tab
ActionClick the Warranty Details tab (it is marked as required).
DescriptionWarranty details must be attached because the ticket is now a RUG repair.
Ticket form — Warranty Details tab
13 Attach the warranty card
NavigationTicket form → Warranty Details → Warranty Card
ActionClick Take a Picture under Warranty Card, go to the location of the image, select the warranty card image and click Open.
DescriptionAttaches a picture of the customer's warranty card to the ticket.
Warranty Details tab — Warranty Card Take a Picture button
Warranty Details tab — Warranty Card attached

Section D — Continue with the RUG process (Step 14)

14 Return
NavigationTicket form → status bar
ActionClick Return and continue with the normal RUG process.
DescriptionRecords the item being received from the customer by creating the Returned Picking (receipt). The ticket is now of type Repair - Under Warranty - RUG, so from here the repair follows the normal RUG process. This is where this tour ends. (The server also raises "You may only return Done pickings" after creating the picking; see the QA notes.)
Ticket form (Type now Under Warranty - RUG) — Return button

QA Notes

  • This tour is about converting a ticket from Under Warranty - External not RUG to Under Warranty - RUG. The tour description lists four moments when this can be done (at ticket creation before the return is received; after receiving the return but before sending to the factory; after sending from the centre but before receipt at the factory; after receiving from the factory but before creating a task); this example follows the first one. After the change the warranty details must be attached, then the normal RUG process is followed. The tour ends at the Return click.
  • The Serial Number field only offers serials already sold to a customer. The tour typed its own serial (0207_001); as required by the test-data rules the automated run picks a serial of [JMC6] whose on-hand quantity is zero (this run used 0701_002), skipping serials that still hold stock in a Repair location from earlier unfinished runs.
  • The tour selects the Return Receipt Location "Jinasena Ampara Branch"; the automated run selects its stock location BR-AM/Stock.
  • The Change to RUG button (action_change_to_rug) is visible in the status bar while the ticket is still of type External not RUG. After clicking it the run verifies through RPC that the ticket type is "Repair - Under Warranty - RUG" (the step 14 screenshot shows the changed Type).
  • The Warranty Card picture is attached by sending WarrantyCard.jpg to the field's hidden file input (the native file chooser opened by Take a Picture cannot be driven by the screenshot flow). The Warranty Details tab is highlighted as required in the screenshot of step 12.
  • The Return button (fix_repair_action_direct_return) raises "You may only return Done pickings" server-side but still creates the Returned Picking first. The automated run clicks the real button and falls back to the same call via /web/dataset/call_kw if no picking appears, then checks that a return picking exists (this run created picking id 21061). The tour ends here, so the receipt is not validated in this guide.
  • Each screenshot is captured immediately before the step's action with the target element framed in red (a temporary CSS outline applied to the live element only for the capture); result screenshots (serial entered, warranty card attached) have no box. Screenshots come from one clean, passing automated run (admin role): ticket REPAIR/2026/01681, 14 steps, 16 screenshots.
  • Every screenshot shows a red "Database neutralized for testing: no emails sent, etc." banner at the top. This is expected on the test database and is not part of the normal production screen.
